mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS pay_order ( biz_order_no VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, channel VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, amount DECIMAL(12,2) NOT NULL, subject VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, notify_url VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, channel_trade_no VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, status TINYINT NOT NULL, payload MEDIUMTEXT NULL, created_at DATETIME(3) NOT NULL, paid_at DATETIME(3) NULL, PRIMARY KEY (biz_order_no), KEY idx_pay_order_trade (channel_trade_no) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pay_order ( biz_order_no, channel, amount, subject, notify_url, channel_trade_no, status, payload, created_at ) VALUES ( #{order.bizOrderNo}, #{order.channel}, #{order.amount}, #{order.subject}, #{order.notifyUrl}, #{order.channelTradeNo}, #{order.status}, #{order.payload}, #{createdAt} ) AS incoming ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE channel = IF(pay_order.status = 1, pay_order.channel, incoming.channel), amount = IF(pay_order.status = 1, pay_order.amount, incoming.amount), subject = IF(pay_order.status = 1, pay_order.subject, incoming.subject), notify_url = IF(pay_order.status = 1, pay_order.notify_url, incoming.notify_url), channel_trade_no = IF(pay_order.status = 1, pay_order.channel_trade_no, incoming.channel_trade_no), payload = IF(pay_order.status = 1, pay_order.payload, incoming.payload)
mapper.select: SELECT biz_order_no, channel, amount, subject, notify_url, channel_trade_no, status, payload FROM pay_order WHERE biz_order_no = #{tradeNo} OR channel_trade_no = #{tradeNo} OR REPLACE(biz_order_no, '-', '') = #{tradeNo} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE pay_order SET status = 1, paid_at = COALESCE(paid_at, #{paidAt}) WHERE biz_order_no = #{bizOrderNo} AND status = 0
